stories.headline: Ninth place Worcester Raiders returned to winning ways last time out as they beat Barnstaple…
stories.body: Ninth place Worcester Raiders returned to winning ways last time out as they beat Barnstaple Town 1-2 on Saturday, following a run of four without a win. In that four match run, Raiders failed to score but did pick ip two 0-0 draws, losing 1-0 in their other two matches.
stories.source_title: Wednesday Night Preview | A look at the four games taking place this evening as we round off the Southern League midweek action
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: The hosts Slimbridge are 20th after a huge 0-2 win at Dorchester Town, which ended…
stories.body: The hosts Slimbridge are 20th after a huge 0-2 win at Dorchester Town, which ended the The Magpies 10 match winning run. The win was The Swans first win at the fifth attempt, and can pick up successive wins for the first time this season if they win tonight.

stories.headline: Exmouth are three without a win, and will be looking to put the weekend's 5-1…
stories.body: Exmouth are three without a win, and will be looking to put the weekend's 5-1 loss to Hungerford Town behind them. The visitors Barnstaple Town sit 19th, having lost the most games in the league with 10.

stories.headline: Weymouth are still unbeaten in the league following a 1-3 win at Shaftesbury.
stories.body: Weymouth are still unbeaten in the league following a 1-3 win at Shaftesbury. Toby Holmes grabbed a brace, moving his season tally to 11, with Tor Swann getting The Terras second of the night in the 26th minute.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Round-Up | Two losing runs ended in the Southern Premier Central as Stamford pick up their first win of the season
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: Santos got Shaftesbury's only goal of the evening, who had James Ward sent off in…
stories.body: Santos got Shaftesbury's only goal of the evening, who had James Ward sent off in the 70th minute with the score 1-2. Swindon Supermarine remained level on points with Weymouth, having played three games extra, following a 1-2 win at bottom of the table Bristol Manor Farm.
